role: Methodological robustness extension only. No observed flower colours or real climate may be opened and no frozen empirical decision may change.

geometry.source: checksum-verified coordinate-only export used by PR #31
geometry.species_split: reuse fixed training/evaluation identity split from hypervolume_actual_support_blocked_transfer_v1
geometry.regional_holdout: reuse all four longitude sectors and 500-km training buffer

estimand: Whether a response-axis distribution learned from training species predicts held-out species in held-out regions better than a finite family of structured no-exact-sharing worlds. This is not a literal estimate of the fraction of biological species sharing an exact threshold.

models.baseline: reuse linear_logit_joint_train from hypervolume_pooled_response_v1 without modification
models.intercept_prior: equal over the fixed five-point grid independently for each species; target labels never update the training sharing posterior
models.score: held-out predictive log-density gain per target photo, averaged equally over target species and four folds

synthetic_generator.shared_axis_rule: round(369 * shared_fraction) species use one common environmental axis; remaining species use independently sampled environmental axes
synthetic_generator.threshold_draw: species thresholds are drawn once per world and reused across every fold/photo occurrence of that species

replication.sharding: deterministic non-overlapping replicate shards are allowed from the outset; no seed/scenario/threshold change after outcomes

calibration.threshold: for each model use the maximum empirical 97.5th percentile, method=higher, across all ten nuisance arms

required_outputs: all calibration and evaluation scores with four fold contributions
all nuisance quantiles and model thresholds
all decision counts and Wilson 95% intervals
directionally clustered and support-aligned nuisance rejection rates
source/code/output checksums and immutable empirical-claim guards
stop_rules: If any fold/species/photo capacity or checksum guard fails, stop without relaxing gates.
If a candidate has excessive rejection under a richer nuisance arm, retain the failure and do not drop that nuisance arm.
Do not open observed colours or real climate based on a favourable robustness result alone.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic robustness of a prespecified predictive-sharing statistic to species-specific threshold shifts and a finite richer family of no-exact-sharing structures on the actual coordinate support. Does not establish real flower-colour sharing, real climatic thresholds, adaptation, causality, prevalence, or a universally calibrated <=5% error rate.
